gen-fs-oswald-gf-bpmf-zihi-kai-std: Compact, confident letters in tight rows. Bpmf Zihi Kai Std follows in sans-serif, friendly and open, with gentle curves; Oswald is best used where a heading can stand up loud and brief.
gen-fs-oswald-gf-elms-sans: Oswald packs its confident, display-sized letters into tightly knit rows, while Elms Sans draws a ballpoint-plain line you can see through. Strong up top, modern below.
gen-fs-oswald-gf-encode-sans-expanded: Encode Sans Expanded spreads out with c shapes whose tips sit well apart, friendly and unfussy beside Oswald's confident, packed display rows. Paragraphs would feel wide and easygoing.
gen-fs-oswald-gf-encode-sans-semi-expand: Oswald is confident and tightly knit, built for display. Encode Sans Semi Expanded is the one to read at length, its rounded letters left open and contemporary, while Oswald does the shouting.
gen-fs-oswald-gf-finlandica: Strong, tight display rows meet something gentler. Finlandica keeps a constant-width outline you could trace with a finger, so a long passage would read clean and unhurried beneath Oswald.
gen-fs-oswald-gf-gotu: Confident, tightly knit display lettering up top, from Oswald. Gotu follows with hairlines of reasonable sturdiness and open-mouthed e crossbars, giving the page a clean, modern counterpart to all that strength.
gen-fs-oswald-gf-gudea: Oswald brings confident display strength in tightly knit rows, best for a heading that needs to hit hard. Gudea follows with curves as thin and constant as a drawn thread, approachable and modern.
gen-fs-oswald-gf-hanken-grotesk: Oswald sets confident, tightly knit display rows with a strong, low-contrast presence, while Hanken Grotesk looks wire-bent across each word. One is built to announce; the other to carry text.
gen-fs-oswald-gf-ibm-plex-sans-hebrew: IBM Plex Sans Hebrew keeps its s and c mouths open and uncrowded, contemporary and approachable in sans-serif. Oswald is the strong, tightly knit display voice for a heading that needs punch.
gen-fs-oswald-gf-kantumruy-pro: Tight, strong display rows set the tone, thanks to Oswald. And Kantumruy Pro keeps diagonals as heavy as its horizontals, with an e that opens to the right, so the text stays plain and approachable.
